sumelamanastiri.name: Sümela Monastery
sumelamanastiri.slogan: A monastery glued to a cliff, 1,200 metres up the Altındere valley.
sumelamanastiri.line: A secret tunnel and unseen frescoes of heaven and hell were found during the 2015–2017 restoration.

trabzonayasofya.name: Trabzon Hagia Sophia
trabzonayasofya.slogan: Byzantine frescoes above the Black Sea, under a dome of 1260.
trabzonayasofya.line: "Take my camel, dear," said my aunt Dot, as she climbed down from this animal on her return from High Mass.
trabzonayasofya.by: Rose Macaulay, The Towers of Trebizond, 1956

uzungol.name: Uzungöl
uzungol.slogan: A landslide dammed a stream and left a mirror among the pines.
uzungol.line: The lake was formed when a landslide blocked the Haldizen Stream; locals call it Şeraho in Romeyka.

ataturkkosku.name: Atatürk Pavilion
ataturkkosku.slogan: A pine-garden villa where Atatürk always stayed in Trabzon.
ataturkkosku.line: Atatürk stayed in this villa on his Trabzon visits, up to his last in 1937; it became a museum in 1943.

boztepeseyir.name: Boztepe
boztepeseyir.slogan: Tea in hand, the whole city and the sea laid out below.
boztepeseyir.line: Boztepe, ancient Mount Minthrion, is still the most popular place to view Trabzon.
